meta.description: Designs and analyzes in vivo CRISPR screens in animal tumor models, organoids, and immune-cell adoptive transfers. Covers bottleneck math, focused-library design, CRISPR-StAR, model selection, tumor-explant DNA recovery, and MAGeCK-based hit calling.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Fresh citation checks confirmed Manguso 2017, Chen 2015, Lee 2023, Uijttewaal 2025, and Fenoglio 2026. All reported numerical claims in executed inputs came from disclosed synthetic data or stated arithmetic.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill concerns preclinical animal research and now requires IACUC or equivalent approval before animal procedures. Scope-boundary testing refused patient-specific therapeutic advice.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill distinguishes model context, bottleneck risk, and primary stable Wald statistics from MLE permutation columns. It includes ethics and 3Rs requirements.

code_usability.detail: MAGeCK count, MLE, six RRA analyses, the shipped per-animal script, and its deterministic rerun executed on fresh synthetic data. The unequal-gene-universe validation gap is a P2 robustness issue, not an inability to execute valid declared inputs.

functional_suitability.note: The Skill covers focused versus genome-scale feasibility, model choice, sequencing recovery, MLE, per-animal RRA, meta-analysis, validation, and documented failure modes.

reliability.note: Version checks, failure-mode guidance, relative Windows-path guidance, determinism caveats, and ethics gates are strong; the meta-analysis does not reject unequal gene universes.

performance_context.note: The 267-line SKILL.md is concise for the workflow and routes the only extended executable to examples/.

agent_usability.note: Decision rules, quantitative thresholds, common errors, validation checklist, and explicit commands make cold-start use clear. The count-library input columns are not shown beside the command.

human_usability.note: The usage guide supplies realistic prompts while SKILL.md gives clear calculations, limitations, and recoverable alternatives.

security.note: No secrets, raw-code evaluation, destructive operations, or sensitive-data leakage occur. The local TSV script should validate input schema and equal gene sets before computation.

maintainability.note: The referenced example is present, compiled, and executed. A small preflight validator would make malformed-data behavior explicit and easier to maintain.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, related-skill routing, IACUC escape hatch, and reproducibility guidance are strong. MLE's known stochastic permutation columns and the incomplete meta-input guard prevent a perfect score.

inputs.label: Focused B16 immune-evasion library at two million cells
inputs.execution_note: Fresh direct execution plus plan_calculations.py: 2,000,000 / 8,000 = 250x pre-bottleneck and 25-50x across the stated five-to-tenfold endpoint loss range.
inputs.note: The design correctly treats the resulting endpoint representation as borderline and requires ethics approval before animal work.

assertions.note: 250x was calculated from two million cells and eight thousand sgRNAs.

assertions.text: Output does not claim an unjustified exact endpoint representation
assertions.note: It uses the Skill's documented 25-50x range.

assertions.text: Output supplies a bottleneck mitigation
assertions.note: Focused-library reduction or sub-pooling is specified.

assertions.text: Output requires animal-ethics approval before implantation
assertions.note: The Ethical and Regulatory Requirements section applies before any procedure.

inputs.label: CRISPR-StAR genome-scale planning example
inputs.execution_note: Fresh plan_calculations.py verified the stated Fenoglio example: 30 million / 30,000 = 1000x pre-implant and 10 million / 30,000 = 333.3x per mouse.
inputs.note: The documented inactive-to-active paired-control sequence and delayed tamoxifen induction are correctly retained; citation metadata was checked against the 2026 Cell Reports Methods record.

assertions.text: Output computes the CRISPR-StAR representations correctly
assertions.note: The fresh arithmetic produced 1000x and 333.3x.

assertions.text: Output preserves the engraftment-before-activation design
assertions.note: It orders engraftment, clone expansion, tamoxifen induction, and paired comparison correctly.

assertions.text: Output does not attribute Fenoglio parameters to the earlier Uijttewaal paper
assertions.note: The Skill explicitly separates the two sources and the audit confirmed the newer paper exists.

assertions.text: Output states that animal procedures require prior approval
assertions.note: The standing ethics section applies to implantation and tamoxifen use.

inputs.label: Eighty-thousand-guide library at one million cells without StAR
inputs.execution_note: Fresh plan_calculations.py calculated 1,000,000 / 80,000 = 12.5x before any engraftment loss.

inputs.note: Relative paths avoid the documented MAGeCK Windows QC-report bug. Wald beta, z, p-value, and FDR columns were identical between MLE runs; permutation p-value/FDR columns drifted as documented.

key_strengths: Every runnable block was freshly executed: MAGeCK count, MLE, per-animal RRA, and the shipped meta-analysis script.
Independent synthetic data recovered all five planted depleted genes under the repaired nominal-p consistency rule and produced no extra compound hits.
The primary RRA path reproduced byte-for-byte, while the Skill accurately documents the separate MLE permutation-column limitation.
Ethical approval, 3Rs, and preclinical practice boundaries are now explicit and apply before animal procedures.

recommendations.title: Validate equal gene universes before meta-analysis
recommendations.problem: The shipped per-animal script silently combines a gene present in only five of six animal files and reports n_animals=5.0, giving that gene a different Stouffer denominator from the rest of the screen.
recommendations.root_cause: The loader skips missing rows and groupby aggregation has no preflight check for equal id sets across the loaded gene_summary files.
recommendations.fix: Before concatenation, compare every input file's id set with the first file and raise a clear error that names missing and extra genes. Alternatively emit a separately labeled incomplete-gene table and exclude it from hit calling.

recommendations.title: Show MAGeCK count library columns
recommendations.problem: The count command names library.csv but does not show that MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 requires three fields: sgRNA id, sequence, and gene. A two-column id/sequence CSV fails before FASTQ processing.
recommendations.root_cause: The command assumes an external library-file convention without documenting the required schema in the Skill.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line CSV header/example immediately before mageck count: sgRNA,sequence,gene, and state that all three fields are required by MAGeCK's --list-seq parser.
